vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-84371
vulnerability.description: sanitize-html (ApostropheCMS fork): Stored XSS via SVG SMIL URI-list scheme-policy bypass

statements.impact_statement: sanitize-html is used to clean author-written rich text before storage (backend/src/config/rich-text.ts:8,51; called from backend/src/services/curriculum-service/curriculum-service.ts:1126,1206), so the vulnerable path is reachable. Bumped backend sanitize-html 2.17.6 -> 2.17.7 (upstream patch commit apostrophecms/apostrophe@1135516), a patch-level release. Verified: 45/45 backend/tests/unit/rich-text.test.ts jest cases pass on the new version.

vulnerability.name: GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr
vulnerability.description: MySQL2: Auth plugin downgrade to mysql_clear_password can leak plaintext credentials to a hostile server

statements.impact_statement: mysql2 is pulled in only as a devOptional transitive of the prisma CLI (backend/package-lock.json:7123 marks devOptional:true; parent prisma@7.9.1 at line 7925). Our Prisma datasource provider is postgresql (backend/prisma/schema.prisma:13), and no source file imports mysql2 (grep -rn 'mysql' backend/src backend/scripts returns 0 hits). The vulnerable code path is the mysql2 client's auth handshake, which requires opening a mysql connection — never executed in our build or runtime, so we cannot be tricked into sending mysql_clear_password. Same reachability profile as [[2026-09-01-pr33491819208-mysql2-dos-not-affected.openvex.json]] for GHSA-rgwj-5xj2-c3m3.
